scope: Blender5.3.0 02f0899d78e3 macOSarm64 modern compositor CPU multi-function single values, including GPU-authored settings; not GPU field arithmetic qualification. Twelve simple modes accept arbitrary exact normal Float32 3D literal vectors/scales with nonzero magnitude[2^-32,2^16], or+0. MADD/CROSS/DOT/DIVIDE retain sixteenth-grid +/-16 bounds, power-of-two nonzero divisors and exact zero-divisor branch. Negative-zero input/product/quotient and Ceil negative-zero hazards refuse. Explicit defaults, typed Vector, Value/CombineXYZ, reroute and group routes; arbitrary computed/field provenance refuses. All measured RGBA words are exact, including alpha1. No arbitrary downstream composition, native-build/platform or shader qualification.

numericContract.gate: All Float32 RGBA output words must equal native words. No output tolerance, signed-zero repair or branch epsilon.
numericContract.input: Actual typed 3D literal vectors and literal Scale with exact Float32 provenance. ADD/SUBTRACT/MULTIPLY/SCALE/MINIMUM/MAXIMUM/ABSOLUTE/FLOOR/CEIL/FRACTION/ROUND/SIGN accept nonzero magnitude[2^-32,2^16], or positive zero. MULTIPLY_ADD/CROSS_PRODUCT/DOT_PRODUCT/DIVIDE retain sixteenth-grid values within +/-16. Bounded earlier-operation provenance resolves only native InputVector, Value, CombineXYZ and flattened group/reroute defaults; computed Vector Math outputs and image fields refuse.
numericContract.arithmetic: Simple modes use the same ordered normal Float32 primitive at every output stage: one add/subtract/multiply or exact input selection/discrete transform; FRACTION is a-floor(a), ROUND is floor(Float32(a+.5)). Products stay within[2^-64,2^32] when nonzero; add/subtract cancellation has smallest nonzero spacing at least2^-55. These are finite normal results, avoiding overflow, underflow and denormal flushing. This scope permits ordinary rounded results and still requires native/browser output words to agree exactly. Compound-mode dyadic inputs are integers/16. Products and power-of-two quotients are multiples of1/256 with bounded magnitude256; cross differences and three-term dot sums remain exact Float32 multiples of1/256 with magnitude<=768, including fused/unfused arithmetic. Nonzero Divide denominators are powers of two; zero divisors use native safe-divide+0.
numericContract.hazards: Negative-zero literal inputs refuse. Multiplication/reduction products and division quotients that could produce negative zero refuse. Native SCALE with a negative component and zero Scale may canonicalize+0 rather than IEEE-0; it remains quarantined. CEIL inputs strictly between-1 and0 refuse. Other transcendental/normalization/project/reflection/remainder modes and arbitrary fields need separate contracts. No output tolerance, shader epsilon or signed-zero output repair is introduced.
numericContract.scope: At the admitted output, not arbitrary downstream composition. Modern native compositor single-value CPU-MF is measured for both CPU/GPU-authored settings; no GPU field arithmetic credit. Actual built browser WebGPU/WebGL2 and Metal/SwiftShader are required separately.

resources: No port-owned textures/render targets or per-frame GPU readback. Three actual Final apply/dispose cycles restore source material/callback ownership and exact independently warmed renderer-owned DFG_LUT identity baseline.
